tools.name: search_frames
tools.description: Search the FrameThrower cinematography reference library by concept, mood, color, composition, or scene. Returns reference frames with film/credits metadata, a preview thumbnail, the full-resolution image URL (use this one for slide decks and documents), and a link to view on FrameThrower.

tools.name: find_by_craft
tools.description: Find frames by specific cinematography craft attributes — lens character, shot size, visual style, setting, time of day, director, or year range. All optional; combine to narrow. Use this to refine a search precisely.

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Find frames visually/semantically similar to a given frame id (from a prior result). Use this to pull more references like one the user shortlisted.

tools.name: get_frame_details
tools.description: Get the full metadata + preview thumbnail + full-resolution image URL + link for a single frame id.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_frames" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
